class.name: CbItemLook
class.brief_description: How a kind of held item looks: the scene drawn in its holder's socket.
class.description: Put it in a world reactions scene ([code]vfx/reactions_*.tscn[/code]). The scene is the item's frame (the socket's): the grip at the origin, pointing along -Z.

members.member: The item kind a server mod declared: [code]melee.bat[/code].
What prompts call it ([code]{look:pickup.target}[/code]): [code]Bat[/code]. Empty: the kind.
The scene drawn in the socket, named [code]Item[/code].
First person: how far the arms holding this are moved in the viewer's own view, in metres to the right, up and ahead. Keep it small. Only the viewer's own picture changes.
